title: Irish-Mexican Breakfast Frittata
description: A spicy twist on the traditional Irish breakfast, incorporating Mexican flavors.
instructions: In a large skillet, sauté the onion and bell pepper until softened.
Add the cooked chorizo and stir to combine.
In a large bowl, whisk the eggs and a pinch of salt.
Add the whisked eggs to the skillet with the chorizo mixture and stir to combine.
Pour the egg mixture into a greased 9-inch (23cm) pie plate or skillet.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the eggs are set.
While the frittata bakes, cook the Irish eggs and crumble them into small pieces.
Once the frittata is done, remove it from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Use a spatula to loosen the edges of the frittata, then slide it onto a plate.
Top the frittata with crumbled Irish eggs, soft-scrambled eggs, and diced delicate eggs.
Sprinkle the shredded Cotija cheese over the top and garnish with chopped cilantro.
Serve warm with salsa on the side.
